name: Global Scraper (All Categories)
purpose: Executes the global scraper to populate missing products for all categories across all supported platforms. Useful for initial data population or massive refreshes.

name: Update Stale Products
purpose: Runs the stale product updater to find older products and re-scrape their specific URLs. This ensures the database doesn't have outdated prices.

name: Start Telegram Bot
purpose: Starts the Telegram Bot to listen for incoming deal messages on Telegram and process their links using Selenium.

name: Run Favorites Service
purpose: Runs the user favorites notification service to check for price drops, stock status changes, and dispatch alerts to users.

name: Automate Banner Extraction
purpose: Extracts banner links and details from retail platforms and stores them under the banners database node.
